title: Best Refurbished Tablets to Buy in the UK (2026)
content_html:
If you want a tablet for streaming, browsing, schoolwork or light productivity without paying full retail price, refurbished models can offer excellent value. This guide highlights the tablet ranges we would check first in the UK.

Rather than chasing one short-lived listing, the links below take you to current eBay UK results so you can compare live prices, condition and seller feedback.

Some links in this article are affiliate links.

1. Apple iPad 10th generation - best all-round choice

The 10th-generation iPad is a strong option for most people. It has a modern design, a large display and enough performance for everyday apps, video, browsing and school or university work.

Best for: buyers who want a recent iPad without paying for a Pro model.

Check current refurbished iPad 10th generation listings on eBay UK

2. iPad Air - best step-up Apple tablet

An iPad Air can be worth the extra money if you want more performance, better accessory support and something that can handle more demanding creative or productivity work.

Best for: students, remote workers and buyers who want something closer to a laptop replacement.

Check current refurbished iPad Air listings on eBay UK

3. Samsung Galaxy Tab S series - best Android option

Samsung's Galaxy Tab S range is the Android alternative we would look at first. These models usually offer strong displays, capable hardware and good multitasking features.

Best for: Android users who want a premium tablet and easy integration with Samsung phones and accessories.

Check current refurbished Galaxy Tab S listings on eBay UK

4. Samsung Galaxy Tab A - best budget Android tablet

The Galaxy Tab A range is more affordable and is often enough for Netflix, YouTube, web browsing, email and children's apps.

Best for: families, casual users and anyone prioritising price over premium performance.

Check current refurbished Galaxy Tab A listings on eBay UK

5. Older standard iPads - best low-cost Apple option

Older standard iPads can still be very useful for light everyday use. The important checks are software support, battery condition and storage capacity.

Browse current refurbished iPad listings on eBay UK

What should you check before buying?

Look at the exact model year, storage size, Wi-Fi or cellular version, cosmetic grade, battery information, warranty and returns. Check whether a charger is included and, if you need a keyboard or stylus, whether the tablet supports the accessory you intend to buy.

Our pick

For most buyers, the standard iPad is the easiest recommendation. If you prefer Android, the Galaxy Tab S range is the stronger premium choice, while the Tab A range makes more sense for a lower budget.

Guide updated September 2026. Prices, promotions, stock and condition change regularly, so always check the live listing before purchasing.
